title: Check inventory v1
description: Validates policy/checks.v1.yaml, the single list of stable check ids. Every id must name the file that states its rule and the method that verifies it, and must resolve either to a gate that executes it or to a deferred obligation that would — never to nothing. An id advertised with neither is gate B3 in the form this plan can close.

release.description: The release surface for the ids in this inventory: which gate item advertises them, and at which stage. The engine's own inventory is advertised by the release table in the composed contract, and needs none of this. A curriculum's inventory is not in that table — phase 3 moved its ids out of the engine's list, and an id that leaves the engine's list and gains no surface of its own has quietly stopped being advertised, which is exactly what happened to the four `L01-*` ids. So the surface moves with the ids rather than disappearing: the curriculum names its own gate items, and `FR-P2-GATEITEMS` holds it to the same two directions it holds the engine's table to — every pattern advertised matches an id in this file, and every staged id in this file is matched by a pattern at its own stage.

id.description: A curriculum check id. Never an FR- id: a refactor gate is not a curriculum check, and the prefixes are what keeps the two apart.

owner.description: The file that states the rule this id checks. It must exist, and it must name the id.

method.description: How the id is verified, from the harness's claim-class vocabulary.

verified_by.description: A gate in this suite that executes the id. Present exactly when the id is VERIFIED HERE.

deferred.description: The deferred obligation that would execute the id. Present exactly when it is MAPPED, NOT EXECUTED.
